item.title: Australian Dollar advances as US Dollar declines ahead of Q3 GDP Annualized
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, following the release of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Minutes of its December monetary policy meeting.

item.title: Japanese Yen builds on strong gains vs. a weaker USD amid divergent BoJ-Fed
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) scales higher against a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD) for the second straight day on Tuesday and has now reversed a major part of the post-Bank of Japan (BoJ) decline last week.

item.title: EUR/GBP declines below 0.8750 as UK GDP matches forecasts
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross trades in negative territory for the fourth consecutive day near 0.8730 during the early European session on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/INR regains ground as India’s weak fundamentals offset RBI’s intervention boost
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) continues to struggle to extend its last week’s reversal move against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair regains ground after posting a fresh over three-week low near 89.25 as Indian importers catch the pullback to add US Dollars at attractive levels.

item.title: GBP/JPY falls from multi-year highs to near 210.30 as Japan warns of intervention
item.description: The GBP/JPY pair retraces to near 210.30 on Tuesday from its multi-year high of 211.60 posted on Monday.

item.title: Gold extends rally to record high as safe-haven demand builds
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) climbs to a record high during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The precious metal has risen 10% over the past month and nearly 70% in 2025 as heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty have boosted demand for safe-haven assets such as Gold.
